raw_segments.text: Cassius, there's a bargain made. Now know you, Casca. I have moved already some certain
of the noblest-minded Romans to undergo with me an enterprise of honorable, dangerous consequence.
And I do know by this, they stay for me in Pompey's porch. For now, this fearful night,
there is no stir or walking in the streets. And the complexion of the element in favors
like the work we have in hand, most bloody, fiery, and most terrible.
